title: The Crab Derby, 2009
logline: Twenty-fifth annual. Gully's engaged. Wood draws the two crabs facing each other for the first time.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY with the twenty. Maria's name on his forearm again — a date in June. WOOD drawing.

characters.pose: twenty, a June date on the arm

image.prompt: a man in an apron holding out a twenty with a June date written on his forearm, a thin man drawing at the counter, a dog, muddy flats
image.notes: JUNE 12 on the arm. Letter after.

panels.composition: The flyer: the two crabs turned to face each other. The cup between them. The small third crab, now beside the second.

image.prompt: close-up of a crab flyer where two large crabs face each other with a cup between them and a small third crab beside one

panels.composition: Gully looking at it. Getting it. Saying nothing.

image.prompt: a man in an apron looking at a flyer and understanding something without saying it, no words

panels.composition: Fifteen flyers. Gully pinning. His hand stays on it a second longer.

image.prompt: fifteen crab flyers in a row, a man in an apron pinning the newest with his hand lingering on it

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: The two crabs face each other. Gully gets it.
